messages:
Maya (docs): Quick heads-up: Python SDK 2.2.0 is published and includes a small but potentially breaking signature change — the `prompt_seed` parameter has been renamed to `seed_prompt` on the generate/completion calls. We shipped a compatibility shim in 2.2.0 that accepts both names for 60 days, but the shim will be dropped in 2.3.0. See the migration guide: https://redwood.example.com/docs/sdk/python/param-rename

Elliot (eng): Is that only on the client side or do server endpoints expect the new name too?

Maya (docs): Good Q — current runtime accepts both keys for backward compatibility for the next 30 days; after that the server will prefer `seed_prompt` and reject `prompt_seed`. The client shim maps `prompt_seed` -> `seed_prompt` by default.

Samira (product): We should flag this in the Console changelog and add a one-sentence customer email. Proposed wording: "Minor SDK parameter rename in Python 2.2.0; automatic compatibility provided for 60 days; upgrade recommended." Thoughts?

Jordan (release): I'll add a short blurb to tomorrow's release notes and include the migration link. Can we also add a deprecation banner in the docs page?

Maya (docs): Yes, added a banner to the guide and a short migration snippet in the Quickstart. Also added a small FAQ entry: "Why was `prompt_seed` renamed?" (clarifies naming consistency across SDKs).

Lin (qa): FYI failing tests in repo `examples/rlhf-samples` — calls that used `prompt_seed` are hitting a validation error on latest CI image.

Elliot (eng): Thanks Lin. I'll push a hotfix to the runtime that keeps accepting `prompt_seed` for 30 more days (server-side). Also adding a CI lint rule that flags the old param in examples.

Maya (docs): Migration snippet (to paste into projects):

```python
# OLD
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.generate(prompt_seed="draft intro")

# NEW
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.generate(seed_prompt="draft intro")
```

Maya (docs): Quick checklist for teams: 1) Update in-repo examples and tests (replace `prompt_seed`), 2) Pin to SDK 2.2.0+ if you rely on the shim, 3) Run `pytest` in CI against the patched runtime image.

Jordan (release): Added console banner and scheduled the customer email for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Samira (product): Can we publish an automated deprecation notice in the admin console for tenants with heavy Python usage? If so, target those with >1M tokens/month.

Elliot (eng): We can. I'll wire a simple rollout job to post the in-console advisory via the admin API — will need a short message from product.

Samira (product): Draft: "Heads-up: Python SDK param rename — please migrate `prompt_seed` to `seed_prompt` within 60 days to avoid future failures. See migration guide: https://redwood.example.com/docs/sdk/python/param-rename"

Maya (docs): docs-bot: changelog entry created -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/2.2.0

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: changelog updated by Maya (docs).

Lin (qa): Re-ran tests against the interim runtime patch — examples repo now green. Will open a PR that replaces the old param across our sample repos.

Elliot (eng): Thanks everyone. Plan: runtime accepts both for 30 days; client shim + docs cover 60 days for devs; removal in 2.3.0. If anyone spots customer breaks, @Elliot (eng) and @Jordan (release) are on-call for rollback. :thumbsup:
